Review for Dental Solution at Bangkok Hospital, Koh Samui

I can only praise the all-round service at Dental Solution in Bangkok Hospital, Koh Samui. First of all, I was able to get an appointment at very short notice. My issue was an inflamed tooth root, with swollen and extremely painful gums. I was given an appointment on the same day, and everything was explained to me transparently.

X-rays were taken, and the further treatment options were discussed in detail. I was presented with three choices, and after making a decision, the procedure was carried out promptly. Just one and a half hours later, I was pain-free and on my way back to the hotel. By the evening, I was already able to resume all my activities, and I have been pain-free ever since.

A huge compliment to the entire team, especially Dr. Wanwimon Potjanatkomon, who treated me with great care and professionalism, and Joy, the assistant, who was incredibly competent and efficient. Joy had already communicated with me in the morning via WhatsApp, providing excellent support and ensuring a smooth process. Her English skills were outstanding, making everything even easier.

The whole team was absolutely excellent – highly recommended for anyone in need of professional and efficient dental care!

We've been waiting in Germany for three months for an appointment to have a wisdom tooth removed. During our vacation, we suddenly experienced severe pain in that tooth again,

so we desperately went to this clinic.

The wisdom tooth surgery went very well.

They were incredibly friendly and competent, and we got an appointment quickly and easily. We're honestly surprised by the other reviews here, as we've been there three times and the other patients always seemed very satisfied.

The price is high, as is standard for private hospitals.
But the orthodontist is only at the clinic two days a month. If a brace comes loose, you have to wait. And the doctor isn't necessarily a good worker.
